title: RPi ROI control membership compares iterators from different temporary maps
description:
GetControls returns its ControlInfoMap by value, but ROI code compares find from one temporary with end from another. That is not a valid same-container membership test and can select unsupported ScalerCrop instead of the full-frame fallback. Store one local map and compare its own iterators; test a camera profile lacking the control. No platform runtime executed. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
